Engaged in Theorems 28.9.1 and 28.9.2 of the present paper as the primary source for the composed Newton-to-fluid pipeline, with the framework's position on the structural relationship to $dx_4/dt = ic$ published in [McGuckenHilbertSixth2026, §11.9].)

338. **[UffinkValente2015]** Uffink, J., \& Valente, G.\ (2015). Lanford's theorem and the emergence of irreversibility. *Foundations of Physics* **45**(4), 404--438. (Analysis of Oscar Lanford's 1975 short-time derivation of the Boltzmann equation from hard-sphere Newtonian dynamics. Reaches the diagnosis that ``no time-asymmetric ingredient at all'' appears at the level of the microscopic dynamics of the derivation, entailing that the irreversibility of the output Boltzmann equation must have been imported through the initial-condition assumption on the ensemble measure or through the convention of the direction in which the limit is taken. Identifies the ensemble measure as the primary carrier of the asymmetry. The paper's diagnosis has been widely cited in subsequent philosophy-of-physics literature on the emergence of irreversibility from time-reversible dynamics. Engaged at §28.9.6.3 and §28.9.6.5 of the present paper as the earlier of the two philosophy-of-physics primary sources identifying the injection sites in the Lanford framework, which are inherited by the Deng--Hani--Ma 2024--2025 extension of that framework to long times.)

339. **[UffinkValente2010]** Uffink, J., \& Valente, G.\ (2010). *Time's arrow and Lanford's theorem.* In: *Séminaire Poincaré XV Le Temps*, Institut Henri Poincaré, Paris, pp.\ 141--173. (Earlier of the two Uffink--Valente treatments of Lanford's theorem. Verified-read via full-text PDF fetch of the Séminaire Poincaré XV Le Temps proceedings volume. Central diagnosis, verbatim from the abstract: ``the true culprit for the emergence of irreversibility lies in a point that has hitherto not been sufficiently emphasized, i.e., in the choice of incoming, rather than outgoing, configurations for collision points.'' Locates the injection at a specific technical point in the Lanford proof — the collision operator's incoming-configuration convention as adopted in the transition from the original BBGKY collision term (Lanford 1975, eq.\ (29)) to its rewritten form (Lanford 1975, eq.\ (32)) — and argues this choice should be recognized as an explicit assumption of the theorem. The 2010 paper's Proposition 3 (pp.\ 168--171 of the *Séminaire Poincaré* volume) proves the BBGKY hierarchy with the incoming-configuration collision term is not time-reversal invariant, and Proposition 2 (pp.\ 168--169) proves the BBGKY hierarchy with the original collision term is time-reversal invariant, isolating the (29)-to-(32) transition as the technical step at which the time-asymmetric content enters. The 2010 position was subsequently modified in Uffink--Valente 2015 [UffinkValente2015] to the wider conclusion that no ingredient of Lanford's theorem is time-asymmetric, and the 2010→2015 position shift was engaged directly by Ardourel 2017 [Ardourel2017], who defended a modified version of the 2010 Uffink--Valente position by arguing that the incoming-configuration convention, when taken within the Boltzmann-Grad limit, is a time-asymmetric ingredient. Engaged at §28.9.6.5(b) of the present paper as the earlier of the two Uffink--Valente treatments, and as the prior-art anchor for the philosophy-of-physics identification of the incoming-configuration convention as an injection site in the Lanford framework inherited by the Deng--Hani--Ma 2024--2025 extension.)

340. **[BodineauGallagherSaintRaymondSimonella2016]** Bodineau, T., Gallagher, I., Saint-Raymond, L., \& Simonella, S.\ (2016/2018). *One-sided convergence in the Boltzmann-Grad limit.* arXiv:1612.03722 [math.AP], published as *Ann.\ Fac.\ Sci.\ Toulouse Math.* (6) **27** (2018), no.\ 5, pp.\ 985--1022. (Dedicated technical review of Lanford's theorem focused on the initial data, by the four mathematicians who are Deng--Hani--Ma's own technical predecessors and the Bourbaki reviewers of the Deng--Hani--Ma long-time proof in the 2026 seminar [Bourbaki2026]. Present-paper evidence status: the abstract is verified-read via arXiv:1612.03722 abstract page and Numdam publisher metadata; the full-paper text is not directly fetched in this writing. Verbatim published-version abstract: ``We review various contributions on the fundamental work of Lanford [21] deriving the Boltzmann equation from (reversible) hard-sphere dynamics in the low density limit. We focus especially on the assumptions made on the initial data and on how they encode irreversibility. The impossibility to reverse time in the Boltzmann equation (expressed for instance by Boltzmann's H-theorem) is related to the lack of convergence of higher order marginals on some singular sets. Explicit counterexamples single out the microscopic sets where the initial data should converge in order to produce the Boltzmann dynamics.'' The paper's use of the wording ``how they encode irreversibility'' places the arrow of time content within the initial-condition specification rather than within the dynamics. Full-paper claims about the specific counterexample sets are not directly verified in the present writing; only the abstract's high-level diagnosis is engaged. Engaged at §28.9.6.5(a) of the present paper as the primary technical-predecessor source identifying the initial-data-encoding-of-irreversibility diagnosis that Deng--Hani--Ma inherit and extend to long times.)

(Full-length study of the location where the arrow of time enters the Lanford framework. Central diagnosis: Boltzmann's 1872 Stosszahlansatz (imposed at every collision) was replaced in Lanford's 1975 derivation by a factorization condition only at the initial time. The asymmetric assumption changed location, moving from the collision-by-collision level to the initial-condition level, rather than being eliminated. Ardourel's paper predates the Deng--Hani--Ma 2024 extension to long times by seven years, yet the diagnosis it develops applies without modification to the Deng--Hani--Ma proof, which preserves the initial-condition-only factorization at $t=0$ and propagates it for longer times via the partial time expansion of [DengHaniMa2024, §1.3.3]. Engaged at §28.9.6.2 and §28.9.6.5 of the present paper as the second philosophy-of-physics primary source identifying the injection sites in the Lanford framework inherited by Deng--Hani--Ma 2024--2025.)

342. **[DekkersLandsman2025]** Dekkers, N., \& Landsman, K.\ (2025). *Irreversibility and randomness.* arXiv:2512.20421 [math-ph]. (Philosophically detailed analysis of Deng--Hani--Ma specifically, published December 2025. Extends the Uffink--Valente 2015 reading of Lanford 1975 to the Deng--Hani--Ma 2024 long-time result. The summary of their §1 identifies the initial-condition ensemble measure as the source of the asymmetry via the observation that ``the i.i.d.\ assumption itself remains unjustified'' (their §1, item 2). Their point 5 diagnoses that irreversibility traces to the time-asymmetry of the algorithmic randomness condition relative to a probability measure that makes the particles i.i.d.\ at $t=0$ specifically. Their conclusion: the Deng--Hani--Ma result is a statement about the expectation value $\langle f_N \rangle_{\mathbb{P}_N}$ under a measure $\mathbb{P}_N$ that hardwires the i.i.d.-at-$t=0$ condition; the result does not establish that any individual microstate typically gives rise to Boltzmann evolution. The paper also develops toy-model results for the Ehrenfest urn model and the Kac ring model to illustrate the algorithmic-randomness reading of irreversibility. Engaged at §28.9.6.2, §28.9.6.3, and §28.9.6.5 of the present paper as the most recent primary source on the injection-site question for the Deng--Hani--Ma proof.)

In this chapter and hereafter, as throughout the literature of general relativity, a real time coordinate is used, $x^0 = t = ct_{\mathrm{conv}}$ (superscript 0 rather than 4 to avoid any possibility of confusion with the imaginary time coordinate)."* Identified in the Einstein's Rejection-Then-Acceptance subsection of the present paper as the canonical pedagogical-historical moment of the abandonment of $x^4 = ict$ in late-twentieth-century graduate-level general-relativity instruction, with the structural cost — the concealment of the perpendicularity-factor content of the imaginary unit inside the metric tensor $\eta_{\mu\nu} = \mathrm{diag}(-1, +1, +1, +1)$ — being the proximate cause of the Huang–Zee–Wolfram–Feynman cluster's persistence as the residual diagnostic of missing content in late-twentieth-century physics.
